Aatrox.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then use an empowered basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If you successfully engage, follow with Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Aatrox.laning: In the early game, focus on farming without giving Aatrox a kill. Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield, but conserve mana at low levels.
Aatrox.escape: Aatrox E Umbral Dash being used is an opportunity to close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains is also down, it’s a good time to engage without risking being pulled back.
Aatrox.teamfight: When Malphite R Unstoppable Force is available, look to knock up two or more enemies or catch a key damage dealer alone. If an ally has an area-of-effect ultimate, time your engage so they can cast it where you knock enemies up.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and W Infernal Chains deal mainly physical damage, so buy Glacial Buckler early and prioritize armor. Then build Plated Steelcaps and other armor items. If healing makes fights drag on, get Thornmail for Grievous Wounds.
Aatrox.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is active. When it breaks, back off and let it recharge. Look to trade just after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from P Deathbringer Stance on a minion, and avoid the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade.
Aatrox.phase: Malphite becomes strong after learning R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as he builds armor items. Late game, focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than dealing damage on your own.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals heavy damage at the edge, so when you see the cast animation, move outside its outer range or close in to the inner area. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, leave its area immediately before it pulls you back.

DrMundo.teamfight: Use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to knock up two or more opponents or target a key damage dealer caught alone.
DrMundo.build: Dr. Mundo’s main damage is the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, so build armor first. Armor also increases the damage from Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam. If the duel goes long, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
DrMundo.combo: Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don’t cast Malphite R Unstoppable Force while his passive is active expecting the knockup. After his passive is down, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam. For a short trade at close range, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no skill that creates distance on its own, so when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and you have an opening, close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Approach with minions between you and Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, account for its healing and movement speed increase and delay your kill attempt.
DrMundo.fight: Trade briefly while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off to recharge it once it breaks. If you’re close, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and attack in this order: basic attack, Malphite E Ground Slam, basic attack. Look for a full fight while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down.
DrMundo.laning: Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions. After a trade, destroy the canister Dr. Mundo drops if you can safely step on it.
DrMundo.phase: Your damage contribution falls off late, so focus on starting team fights as Malphite.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target and deals damage based on current health, so be especially careful at high health and stand behind minions. Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma empowers his basic attack, so use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed after he starts attacking. Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage increases his healing and movement speed, so don’t focus on killing him while it’s active.

Jax.teamfight: If Jax activates E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t group up nearby and avoid its stun range. If an ally has an area-of-effect ultimate, coordinate your Malphite R timing with that ultimate.
Jax.phase: In the late game, Malphite contributes less damage, so focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Jax.build: Build armor items first to withstand basic attacks and increase the damage from Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam. Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build magic resistance too. Avoid stacking health alone, since Counter Strike deals damage based on maximum health.
Jax.combo: For a short trade after Jax E Counter Strike ends, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also down and you can engage with your ultimate, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax uses Q Leap Strike is an opportunity to close the gap. Engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force after the stun from Jax E Counter Strike ends to avoid having your basic attacks negated during Counter Strike.
Jax.fight: Trade briefly while P Granite Shield is ready, then back off to recharge it when it breaks. Don’t basic attack during Jax E Counter Strike. After it ends, if Jax starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed.
Jax.laning: Then poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard and back off to recharge P Granite Shield. At low levels, don’t cast Q on cooldown, so you don’t run out of mana. When Jax E Counter Strike is down, pressure him with your jungler to build a CS and level lead.
Jax.watch: Jax can close the gap with Q Leap Strike, so don’t close the distance again before Counter Strike ends.

Quinn.teamfight: Create team fights rather than facing Quinn alone in a side lane. If Quinn enters from the flank, stop her with the knockup from Malphite R Unstoppable Force. If two or more enemies, including Quinn, group together, look for an angle to knock them all up.
Quinn.build: Buy Glacial Buckler early to match Quinn's damage, then build Plated Steelcaps. More armor afterward also increases Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Follow with Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault is Quinn's only mobility spell, so the moment after she uses it is your window to engage. Close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force; if it's unavailable, don't force a chase.
Quinn.fight: Don't try to engage first in the early game; trade after Quinn E Vault is down. When Quinn starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce her attack speed, then land the empowered basic attack from Malphite W Thunderclap.
Quinn.laning: Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off to recharge the shield. Mana can run low at low levels, so don't cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard every time it's up.
Quinn.phase: Right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as you build armor, look for an opening while Quinn E Vault is down. In the late game, focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than dueling.
Quinn.watch: Quinn E Vault knocks Malphite back and slows him before Quinn retreats, so don't force an engage while it's available. When marked by Quinn P Harrier, move out of basic attack range to avoid the empowered attack. Stand behind minions so Quinn Q Blinding Assault hits a minion first.

Singed.teamfight: Don't chase Singed to the ends of the map or commit multiple players to catching him. If Singed dives your allies, lock him down with Malphite R Unstoppable Force and attack his allies in the meantime. When enemies are grouped, knock up at least two or target a key damage dealer caught alone, and coordinate with your team's AoE ultimates.
Singed.watch: Don't chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. While standing on Singed W Mega Adhesive, you can't dash with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, so go around the area. Singed E Fling throws Malphite behind Singed, so keep your distance if Singed's allies are behind him.
Singed.build: Singed's main damage is magic, and Malphite has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Then build Hollow Radiance for magic resistance and farming power, but keep one armor item for the damage of Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam.
Singed.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. To engage, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W Thunderclap → basic attack → Q Seismic Shard → E Ground Slam.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force when you have an opening to catch him. However, you can't dash while standing on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so move off it before engaging. Check your position so you can avoid Singed W Mega Adhesive and E Fling being chained together.
Singed.fight: Trade briefly while Malphite P Granite Shield is up. When it breaks, back off and let it recharge. Slow Singed with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then create distance while he can't catch up. Don't chase through Singed Q Poison Trail unless you have enough damage to finish him for sure.
Singed.laning: Don't cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard every time it's ready early on, so you don't run low on mana. After poking, back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. When you get an advantage, push the wave and damage the turret.
Singed.phase: Look for openings to engage right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game as you build armor. In the late game, focus on starting teamfights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than dealing damage.

Trundle.teamfight: Use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to knock up at least two grouped enemies or target a key damage dealer caught alone. Don't let a frontline ally hit by Trundle R Subjugate fight Trundle alone; attack a different target in the meantime. Coordinate the timing of Malphite R with your team's AoE ultimates if they have one.
Trundle.phase: In the late game, Malphite contributes less damage, so focus on starting team fights.
Trundle.build: Build armor first to reduce physical damage from Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Armor also helps the damage of Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam. Trundle R Subjugate reduces your resistances and deals damage based on your max health, so don't respond by stacking only health or more resistances.
Trundle.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. Use E after Trundle starts a basic attack to limit the attack speed increase from Trundle W Frozen Domain. To engage, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → E.
Trundle.escape: Engage when Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and you can fight outside Trundle W Frozen Domain. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force then. If Trundle R Subjugate is active, delay your engage and create distance.
Trundle.fight: Trade briefly while Malphite P Granite Shield is up. Activate Malphite W Thunderclap and land a basic attack; when Trundle starts attacking, use Malphite E Ground Slam to lower his attack speed, then land one more basic attack. Don't continue the fight on Trundle W Frozen Domain; back off.
Trundle.laning: Don't cast Q every time it's ready, so you don't run low on mana. Trundle P King's Tribute heals him whenever a nearby unit dies, so if you've reduced health through damage, secure an immediate advantage, for example by pushing the wave to force a recall.
Trundle.watch: Trundle's attack speed increases on Trundle W Frozen Domain, so don't fight inside it; back out. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape and slows you, so avoid narrow paths and move to the side as soon as the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, your resistances are reduced and Trundle becomes tougher, so create distance.

Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave can’t hit several champions and give him a large shield. Keep track of the back of your formation, since Yone R Fate Sealed moves him behind the last champion it hits. Use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to knock up two or more grouped enemies or target a key damage dealer caught alone, and coordinate with an allied AoE ultimate.
Yone.build: Get armor items first. Armor also boosts the damage of Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on just one type of resistance afterward. Also, avoid stacking health alone because Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health.
Yone.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → E Ground Slam → basic attack. Use E after Yone starts attacking, and don’t back off immediately after activating W; land two empowered basic attacks. When Yone’s mobility spell is down, engage with your ultimate using Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W Thunderclap → basic attack → Q Seismic Shard → E Ground Slam.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because Yone has used one Q Mortal Steel; check whether E Soul Unbound and R Fate Sealed are still available too. In particular, close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force when Yone R is down and the stacks for his tornado Q have disappeared. If Yone engages first with E, look for a chance to stop his return with Malphite R’s knockup.
Yone.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off and let it recharge when it breaks. After Yone starts a basic attack, hit him with Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed. Don’t engage first while Yone’s tornado from Q Mortal Steel is ready.
Yone.laning: Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then use the slow to back off and let your shield recharge. Mana may be scarce early, so don’t cast Q every time it’s up, and keep your distance when Yone’s tornado from Q Mortal Steel is ready.
Yone.phase: Yone is weak early, before he gets attack speed, but Malphite also has trouble getting a kill before learning R Unstoppable Force. Look actively for opportunities right after learning R and in the mid game as you accumulate armor items. In the late game, focus on starting teamfights with R rather than dealing damage.
Yone.watch: If Yone keeps casting Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado is charging, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. When he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can deal more damage as he returns, so keep a generous health buffer. In teamfights, watch the path of Yone R Fate Sealed and where he ends up behind the last champion hit.

Akali.teamfight: Don’t start a fight while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. Watch whether Akali still has another mobility option, and look to knock up two or more enemies or catch a key damage dealer alone. If an ally has an area-of-effect ultimate, time it to follow Malphite R’s knock-up.
Akali.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is active. When it breaks, back off and let it recharge. When Akali comes out of W Twilight Shroud to engage, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and trade back with basic attacks. Dodge the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip, then look for an opening to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force after her mobility is down.
Akali.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Akali’s main damage is magic, and Malphite has low magic resistance, so build Hollow Radiance to raise it further. Leave room for one armor item to boost Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam damage.
Akali.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → E Ground Slam → basic attack. After activating W, land two basic attacks to use its empowered effect. When Akali’s mobility is down and you can engage with your ultimate, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W Thunderclap → basic attack → Q Seismic Shard → E Ground Slam.
Akali.escape: If only one of Akali W Twilight Shroud or E Shuriken Flip is down, she can escape with her remaining movement options, so don’t rush your engage. Look especially for a window before Akali R Perfect Execution is ready again, and close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Save Malphite’s mobility to deal with the first dash of Akali R.
Akali.laning: Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge P Granite Shield, but don’t cast Q on cooldown while its skill rank is low. Build a health and CS lead while Akali’s ultimate is down, then push the wave and damage her turret to extend your lead.
Akali.phase: Malphite is strong just after learning R Unstoppable Force and in mid game, as he builds two or three armor items. His damage contribution falls off late, so focus on starting team fights with R.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, the second dash will follow Malphite as he tries to escape. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, and its second hit deals more damage based on your missing health, so don’t fight back while low.

Gangplank.teamfight: Don’t start a fight without Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Use your ultimate when two or more opponents are grouped or a key damage dealer is caught alone. Coordinate with allied area-of-effect ultimates if you have them. In objective fights, also check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used.
Gangplank.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then get Plated Steelcaps; armor also increases the damage from Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam. Resistances won’t help against the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, so build health too. If his healing is a problem, finish Thornmail first.
Gangplank.combo: When engaging after Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam. For a short trade without your ultimate, attack in this order: Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so look to engage just after he places Gangplank E Powder Keg or just after a keg is destroyed. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, look for an angle to close the gap and knock him up with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Delay your engage if there’s a primed E Powder Keg nearby.
Gangplank.fight: Start a trade with Malphite P Granite Shield ready, and look for an opening just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, before the keg is primed. When you briefly close in, use Malphite W Thunderclap to empower your basic attack and Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his retaliation. If there’s a primed keg nearby, back off and recharge your shield.
Gangplank.laning: With Malphite P Granite Shield ready, poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge your shield. Build armor early to withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley. Don’t fight near a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg, and if you gain an advantage, push the lane and damage the turret.
Gangplank.phase: Look for opportunities aggressively from right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force through mid game, when you’ve built two or three armor items. Your damage contribution falls off late, so focus on starting team fights with your ultimate.
Gangplank.watch: Don’t engage near a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg or where two kegs overlap. Destroy kegs from outside their blast range, and watch out for the true damage and movement speed increase from Gangplank P Trial by Fire.

Jayce.teamfight: Don’t start a fight without Malphite R Unstoppable Force. After Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, look to engage on Jayce or knock up two or more opponents when they group up.
Jayce.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast and his basic attacks. Armor also increases the damage from Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam. Jayce hammer W Lightning Field and E Thundering Blow deal magic damage that armor can’t reduce, so add magic resistance based on the enemy team’s magic damage.
Jayce.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If Jayce’s leap is down and you can engage with your ultimate, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Jayce.escape: Immediately after you force Jayce to use Q To the Skies!, you have an opportunity to engage. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is also down, you’re less likely to get pushed away when you engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Jayce.fight: Trade briefly while Malphite P Granite Shield is ready, then back off to recharge it when it breaks. When Jayce enters with his hammer and starts a basic attack, land an empowered attack with Malphite W Thunderclap, then use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed. After Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Jayce.laning: Move sideways to dodge the line from Jayce Q Shock Blast. Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. Mana is limited early, so don’t cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard on cooldown. If health has dropped substantially, clear the wave and recall.
Jayce.phase: Right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as you build armor, look for openings while Jayce’s leap is down. Your damage contribution falls off late, so focus on starting team fights with your ultimate.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may arrive soon, so sidestep out of its path. When Jayce is holding his hammer, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.

Nasus.teamfight: Move with allies so Nasus W Wither does not catch you alone, and keep your distance while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active. Use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to knock up two or more enemies or target a key damage dealer who is alone. If an ally has an area-of-effect ultimate, coordinate the timing of your engage.
Nasus.build: Build armor first to counter Nasus's main damage, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Armor also helps Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam deal more damage. Nasus E Spirit Fire and Nasus R Fury of the Sands deal magic damage that armor cannot block, so do not rely on armor alone to stand in the area or his ultimate.
Nasus.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. When you have an opening to engage and finish him, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no ability to create distance, so look for an engage after Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands has ended. Close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, but first consider whether you may need it to escape a gank.
Nasus.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off and let it recharge when it breaks. After Nasus starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed and limit his retaliation with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Look for an opening when Nasus R Fury of the Sands is not active.
Nasus.laning: Do not push the lane indiscriminately and give Nasus an easy spot to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike under his turret. Let the lane come to you, pressure his last-hits, and call for a jungle gank. Use Malphite Q Seismic Shard to poke while managing your mana, then back off and recharge Malphite P Granite Shield.
Nasus.phase: Look for opportunities to be aggressive right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game as you build armor items. Nasus grows stronger over time while Malphite contributes less damage in the late game, so focus on starting teamfights.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes more threatening as it stacks, so pressure him early and make it difficult for him to last-hit. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so step out of the area. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting him head-on and wait out its duration.

Renekton.teamfight: Don't start a fight when Malphite R Unstoppable Force is unavailable. Use R to knock up two or more enemies or catch a key damage dealer who is alone, and coordinate the timing if an ally has an AoE ultimate.
Renekton.build: Renekton deals mostly physical damage, so buy Glacial Buckler early, then build Plated Steelcaps and other armor items. If Renekton Q Cull the Meek's healing is a problem, finish Thornmail first. Armor also increases Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage, but it won't block the magic damage from Renekton R Dominus.
Renekton.combo: When Renekton is nearby, take a short trade with Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down and you can engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, use R → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Renekton.escape: The moment after Renekton E Slice and Dice is down is your chance to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Especially if Renekton W Ruthless Predator has also been used, look for an opening to counterattack after his first combo ends.
Renekton.fight: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is empty, take a short trade while Malphite P Granite Shield is charged. Activate Malphite W Thunderclap and land an empowered basic attack; when Renekton starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his retaliation, then land one more basic attack. Slow him with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge your shield.
Renekton.laning: Repeat the cycle of recharging your shield, poking with Q, and backing off; look for an opening when Renekton steps forward to hit minions. Don't stand in or behind a minion wave where Renekton E Slice and Dice can use it as a launch point for an engage.
Renekton.phase: Malphite becomes strong in the mid game after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and accumulating two or three armor items. His damage contribution decreases in the late game, so focus on initiating fights with your ultimate in teamfights.
Renekton.watch: If Renekton P Reign of Anger is near or above half, watch for the empowered stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of range. Empowered W breaks Malphite P Granite Shield first, so don't rely on the shield to absorb his combo. Renekton E Slice and Dice can hit a minion to enable a second dash, so avoid standing in or behind a minion wave.

Tryndamere.teamfight: Don't start a fight while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. Use R to knock up at least two grouped enemies or target a key damage dealer caught alone, and coordinate with your team's AoE ultimates if they have one. If Tryndamere is split-pushing with R Undying Rage ready, don't go alone to stop him; send more players or trade for an objective.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere to keep him from building Fury with last hits, but conserve mana when using Malphite Q Seismic Shard. If Tryndamere builds Fury by attacking minions, he may engage soon, so keep your distance.
Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere's main damage is physical and relies on critical strikes, so build armor first. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then build Plated Steelcaps. When you need to reduce his healing, complete Thornmail first, then build more armor with Frozen Heart and Randuin's Omen.
Tryndamere.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then attack in this order: basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. Use E after Tryndamere starts a basic attack to reduce his retaliation. To engage, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → E just after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after you make Tryndamere use E Spinning Slash is your chance to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Where there are lots of minions, Tryndamere's critical strikes can let him use E again quickly, so target him where there are no minions or knock him up with R just after E is down. When backing off, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.fight: Trade briefly while Malphite P Granite Shield is full. When it breaks, back off and let it recharge. When Tryndamere starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to lower his attack speed and reduce his retaliation. Create distance while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, then deal damage again after it ends.
Tryndamere.phase: Look actively for opportunities right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game after building two or three armor items. Your damage contribution falls in the late game, so focus on starting teamfights with R.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere P Battle Fury is stacked, his critical strikes are threatening, so keep your distance while he builds Fury by hitting minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash can be used again quickly after a critical strike, so don't chase him where there are lots of minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop dealing damage and create distance until it expires.

Yorick.teamfight: Don’t start a fight without Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Engage when two or more enemies are grouped, or target a key damage dealer caught alone. Coordinate R’s timing with an allied AoE ultimate if they have one.
Yorick.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stack health alone; get magic resistance too if that damage is a concern.
Yorick.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. To engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, follow up with R → W → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → E.
Yorick.escape: Engage when Yorick E Mourning Mist has missed and Yorick W Dark Procession is also down. Yorick has no mobility spell, so clear his Mist Walkers before closing the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Yorick.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off and let it recharge when it breaks. When Yorick starts retaliating with basic attacks, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed. It’s better to clear Yorick’s Mist Walkers before engaging him.
Yorick.laning: Save mana and step forward to farm while Yorick E Mourning Mist has missed. Push the wave so enemies die under Yorick’s turret, making it harder for him to build graves.
Yorick.phase: Look for engage opportunities right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game as you accumulate armor items. In the late game, focus on starting teamfights with R instead of dealing damage yourself.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you and deals damage based on your maximum health, so watch the projectile’s path and dodge it. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, break the wall with basic attacks. If the Maiden of the Mist from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.

Gwen.phase: Use your strength right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game when you’ve built two or three armor items, while also getting the magic resistance you need against this opponent. Late game, focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force instead of dealing damage yourself.
Gwen.teamfight: Don’t start a fight without Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Knock up two or more opponents when they group up, including Gwen, or target a key damage dealer caught alone. If an ally has an area-of-effect ultimate, time it to hit the targets you knock up with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Gwen.build: Since most of Gwen’s damage is magic, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Get Hollow Radiance for magic resistance and wave clear, but keep one armor item for the damage from Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam.
Gwen.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. After Gwen starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce her retaliation. To engage with your ultimate, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Gwen.escape: Immediately after you force Gwen to use E Skip 'n Slash, you have an opportunity to close the gap. Engage then with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, but don’t cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard from outside the mist while Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active.
Gwen.fight: Stay outside basic attack range to deny healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts, then trade briefly when Malphite P Granite Shield is ready. When Gwen starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce her attack speed. Sidestep the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.laning: Mana is limited early, so don’t cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard on cooldown. Push and damage the turret to build your advantage while denying Gwen the basic attacks she needs to heal.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s cone deals true damage, so sidestep when she casts it. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target her from outside the mist, so enter it or wait for it to end.

Aurora.teamfight: Don’t start a fight while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. Look to knock up two or more enemies or catch a key damage dealer alone, and time Malphite R with an ally’s area-of-effect ultimate if they have one. If Aurora jumps in and can’t secure a takedown, that’s an opportunity to catch her. When retreating, don’t leave a low-health ally behind.
Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, and Malphite has low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Build Hollow Radiance for magic resistance and farming power.
Aurora.combo: After Aurora’s escape tools are down, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → empowered basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam. You can land Malphite Q Seismic Shard and E Ground Slam during the knock-up from Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Aurora.escape: If only Aurora W Across the Veil is down, she can escape with Aurora E The Weirding or R Between Worlds, so don’t rush your engage. Engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force when both Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are down, especially before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back.
Aurora.fight: While Malphite P Granite Shield is charged, poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off before the slowed Aurora can catch up and recharge your shield. If both Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are down, close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. The best opening is when Aurora R Between Worlds is also down.
Aurora.laning: Aurora’s ranged poke can interrupt Malphite P Granite Shield’s regeneration, so take short trades and back off to sustain in lane. When you gain an advantage, push the wave and damage her turret.
Aurora.phase: Malphite is strong just after learning R Unstoppable Force and in mid game, so look for a window when Aurora’s mobility is down. Late game, focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than dealing damage.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and that damage increases with your missing health. If cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora, and back off before the recall if you’re low. Move away before Aurora R Between Worlds appears, or commit only if you’re ready to fight inside its area.

Garen.teamfight: Don’t start a fight without Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Engage when the opponents group up to knock up two or more, or target a key damage dealer caught alone. Coordinate with allied area-of-effect ultimates if you have them.
Garen.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment, and buy Glacial Buckler early. Then get Plated Steelcaps and more armor, but also build health since armor can’t reduce the true damage from Garen R Demacian Justice.
Garen.combo: For a short trade when Garen Q Decisive Strike is down, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. When you can engage, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Garen.escape: Engage after Garen Q Decisive Strike is used on a minion or its empowered attack has been used. If Garen has just activated W Courage, wait out the brief shield and tenacity window, then engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly just after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used, while Malphite P Granite Shield is up. When Garen starts basic attacking, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed, then back off before Garen E Judgment lasts too long. If Garen activates W Courage, delay Malphite R Unstoppable Force by half a beat.
Garen.laning: Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. Mana is limited early, so don’t cast Q on cooldown. Push and pressure the lane to delay Garen W Courage’s growth stacks.
Garen.phase: Look for engage opportunities right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as you build armor. Garen’s growth stacks make things unfavorable later, so focus on starting team fights as Malphite.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack applies silence, so don’t engage first while it’s active. Garen E Judgment deals more damage the longer you stay close, so get out of its spin range. If you’re below half health, watch for Garen R Demacian Justice and stay out of range.

Olaf.teamfight: Do not start a fight without Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Instead of expecting to knock up Olaf while Olaf R Ragnarok is active, target two or more grouped enemies or a key damage dealer who is alone. If an ally has an area-of-effect ultimate, time your engage so they can use it where you knock enemies up.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf's main damage, Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then build Plated Steelcaps, Thornmail, Frozen Heart, and Randuin's Omen. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor cannot reduce, so you also need health.
Olaf.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If you can engage after Olaf R Ragnarok ends, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance, so look for an opening when he has thrown Olaf Q Undertow's axe somewhere difficult to retrieve. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance first; after it ends, engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force to knock him up.
Olaf.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off and let it recharge when it breaks. If you are close to Olaf, use Malphite E Ground Slam after he starts a basic attack to reduce his attack speed. Even if Olaf's health decreases, his attack speed and life steal increase, so do not keep fighting recklessly.
Olaf.laning: To avoid running out of mana, do not cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard every time it is off cooldown at low levels. Move opposite to where Olaf Q Undertow's axe lands to make it harder for him to retrieve it and approach.
Olaf.phase: Look for engage opportunities right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game as you build armor items. Malphite contributes less damage in the late game, so focus on starting fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows you and reduces your armor, so move away from where the axe lands. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor cannot reduce; when your health is low, rely on Malphite P Granite Shield and distance to survive. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, do not expect the airborne effect from Malphite R Unstoppable Force to work; create distance instead.

Riven.teamfight: Don't start a fight when Malphite R Unstoppable Force is unavailable. If Riven engages and threatens your allies, look for an angle to knock her up after her chain starts. If the enemy team groups together, target two or more enemies or a key damage dealer who is alone. Coordinate the timing if an ally has an AoE ultimate.
Riven.build: Riven deals physical damage, so build armor first. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then Plated Steelcaps, and keep building armor afterward. More armor also increases Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage.
Riven.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. After Riven's mobility spells are down, engage with your ultimate using Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Riven.escape: After Riven has used up Riven Q Broken Wings, check whether Riven E Valor has also been spent before engaging. Riven can escape with her remaining dashes, so close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force while both mobility abilities are fully spent.
Riven.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up; if it breaks, back off and recharge it. When Riven gets close and starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce her attack speed. After Riven starts her combo, knock her up with Malphite R Unstoppable Force to interrupt the rest of her chain.
Riven.laning: Conserve mana in the early game: poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back away from the slowed Riven to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. If Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, counterattack while her main damage source and escape are unavailable.
Riven.phase: Right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as you build armor, look for an opening while Riven's mobility spells are down. Late game, focus on starting team fights with your ultimate rather than dealing damage directly.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor can chain dashes, so move back when you see her first dash. When Riven activates Riven R Blade of the Exile, her attack damage and range increase, and her finishing damage increases in proportion to missing health. Create distance until the effect ends, especially when health is low.

Sion.teamfight: Don't start a fight while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. Engage when enemies are grouped to knock up at least two, or target a key damage dealer caught alone. After taking Sion down, reposition instead of continuing to fight where Sion P Glory in Death revives him.
Sion.build: Buy armor first to prepare for the main damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor also boosts the damage of Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam. Sion W Soul Furnace and E Roar of the Slayer deal magic damage, so armor alone won't stop them; dodging E Roar of the Slayer is especially important.
Sion.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → E Ground Slam → basic attack. To engage, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W Thunderclap → basic attack → Q Seismic Shard → E Ground Slam. If Sion has just activated W Soul Furnace, look for an opening to break the shield first with this combo.
Sion.escape: Engage after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash's charged attack or making him use it early. While Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, he has no other mobility ability, giving you a chance to close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Sion.fight: Start trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up. When it breaks, back off and let it recharge. In melee trades, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then attack in this order: basic attack, E Ground Slam, basic attack. If Sion has just activated W Soul Furnace, look for a chance to break the shield first and prevent the explosion.
Sion.laning: Early on, poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. Manage your casts so you don't run low on mana. Watch the direction of Sion Q Decimating Smash's charge and dodge sideways while farming. Sion gains max health from killing units, so push the wave to disrupt his farming or make plays in other lanes.
Sion.phase: Malphite is strong right after learning his ultimate and in the mid game as he builds armor. In the late game, don't let Sion's max health keep increasing unchecked, and focus on starting teamfights with your ultimate.
Sion.watch: When Sion charges Q Decimating Smash, dodge to the side to avoid the knockup and stun. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught charges in a straight line, so dodge sideways instead of running forward or backward. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor if it hits, so don't force a trade right afterward.

Udyr.teamfight: Don’t force a kill on Udyr once he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to knock up two or more grouped enemies, or target a key damage dealer caught alone. Coordinate your engage timing with an allied AoE ultimate if they have one.
Udyr.build: Build armor first to mitigate Udyr’s main damage. If the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm is a concern, get some magic resistance too, but keep your armor items for Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage. Since Udyr deals damage based on your maximum health, avoid stacking health alone.
Udyr.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. After Udyr starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his retaliation. If you engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, follow up with Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. If you’ve already absorbed one stun, use the window when he can’t stun the same target again for a while to retaliate or disengage. Immobilizing effects don’t affect Udyr while E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, so wait until the effect ends before trying to catch him with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Udyr.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off and let it recharge when it breaks. After Udyr starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed. Pressure him again once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so ward key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t push forward when he’s out of sight. Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off and let Malphite P Granite Shield recharge. Mana is scarce early, so don’t cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard every time it’s up.
Udyr.phase: Look for engage opportunities right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game, once you have two or three armor items. In the late game, focus on starting teamfights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than dealing damage.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede increases his movement speed and lets him charge in to stun you, so watch for an engage right after he activates the stance anew. Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered basic attacks and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t trade for long.

Camille.teamfight: When Malphite R Unstoppable Force is available, look to knock up two or more enemies or catch a key damage dealer alone. Camille can’t be targeted as she engages with R The Hextech Ultimatum, so don’t waste a response ability during that moment.
Camille.build: Buy Glacial Buckler early and prioritize armor against Camille’s main damage. Then consider Plated Steelcaps, Thornmail, and Frozen Heart. If healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep is a problem, finish Thornmail first. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s true damage isn’t mitigated by armor, but be careful about stacking only health because of Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Camille.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. Hit Camille with Malphite E Ground Slam after she starts a basic attack to reduce her return damage. To engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, use R → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Camille.escape: Look for an opening when Camille E Hookshot’s stun is down. Camille can also move with R The Hextech Ultimatum, so don’t commit deeply just because E is down. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is also not ready again yet, close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Camille.fight: Start a trade while Malphite P Granite Shield is charged, and avoid trading just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates. When your shield breaks, back off and let it recharge.
Camille.laning: Stand away from walls and among minions to reduce Camille E Hookshot’s engage angle. Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield, but conserve mana early. Take lane control and pressure Camille’s farming before her first core item.
Camille.phase: Camille is also weak before her first core item, so pressure her farming then. Make use of Malphite’s power just after learning R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as armor items stack. After mid game, Camille can quickly take side lane turrets, so don’t leave a side lane unattended. Late game, focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot lets her engage from far away using a wall and stun you, so stand away from walls. Don’t use a response ability at the instant Camille enters with R The Hextech Ultimatum; if trapped, wait out its duration, then fight back.

Gnar.teamfight: Don’t stand with your back to a wall, and be careful fighting in narrow terrain so Mega Gnar can’t stun you by knocking you into a wall with R GNAR! Right after Mega Gnar changes back to Mini, start a team fight with your allies during the window when he can’t transform again.
Gnar.build: Gnar’s main damage is physical, so buy Glacial Buckler early and prioritize armor. Continue into Plated Steelcaps and other armor items to increase your survivability and the damage from Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam. Consider Gnar W Hyper / Wallop’s max-health damage before choosing to stack health alone.
Gnar.combo: If Mini Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam. When you can take a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack.
Gnar.escape: Look to engage just after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used. Right after Mega Gnar changes back to Mini, he can’t transform again for a while, so look for an all-in. If Mega Gnar still has crowd control, avoid engaging near a wall.
Gnar.fight: While Malphite P Granite Shield is charged, poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to a range where you won’t take damage and recharge the shield. If Gnar starts trading back with basic attacks, hit him with Malphite E Ground Slam to lower his attack speed. Just after Mini Gnar uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch, you can close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Gnar.laning: Mini Gnar’s ranged poke can interrupt Malphite P Granite Shield’s regeneration, so if it’s hard to close in, farm near your turret and watch his transformation cycle. Fight during the window immediately after Gnar changes from Mega to Mini, when he can’t transform again yet.
Gnar.phase: Look actively for engage opportunities just after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as two or three armor items stack. Malphite’s damage contribution falls off late, so focus on starting team fights with your ultimate.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows you, and Mini Gnar’s boomerang can hit on its return, so move out of its path. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your max health, so armor alone won’t stop it. Don’t stand with your back to a wall when Mega Gnar can use R GNAR!

Kayle.teamfight: Look for an angle to hit Kayle with R from the side or out of vision so she cannot attack from the backline. It is best to engage after Kayle R Divine Judgment is down. If it is still available, coordinate allied crowd control with Malphite R Unstoppable Force to run out the invulnerability. If reaching Kayle directly is difficult, start the teamfight from an angle that can knock up two or more enemies.
Kayle.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kayle deals mainly magic damage, so build more magic resistance with Hollow Radiance. Keep at least one armor item to preserve the damage from Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam.
Kayle.combo: After Kayle R Divine Judgment is down, engage in this order: Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam. If Kayle activates R first, you can keep her in place with the airborne effect from Malphite R, but use your damaging abilities after her invulnerability ends.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, so look for a chance to close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force when you dodge the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast.
Kayle.fight: If you are close to Kayle, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and basic attack, then use Malphite E Ground Slam when she starts a basic attack.
Kayle.laning: Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off and recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. Do not cast Q every time it is off cooldown, so you do not run out of mana. Kayle is vulnerable to ganks, so call your jungler and turn early lane control into turret pressure.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces Malphite's magic resistance and armor and slows him, so avoid a direct hit. When Kayle P Divine Ascent has built up her attack speed, use Malphite E Ground Slam just after Kayle starts a basic attack to reduce her retaliation. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, do not commit your damage; wait for the invulnerability to end.

Ornn.teamfight: Do not start a fight without Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Avoid the straight line between Ornn and the elemental from Ornn R Call of the Forge God, and look for an angle to knock up two or more enemies or engage on a key damage dealer who is alone. If an ally has an area-of-effect ultimate, time it to follow the airborne effect from Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Ornn.build: Build armor first, since Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage scale with armor. Also build magic resistance against the magic damage from Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health stack alone.
Ornn.combo: For a melee damage trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and attack in this order: basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. Use Malphite E Ground Slam after Ornn starts a basic attack to reduce his retaliation. To engage with your ultimate, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Ornn.escape: Even if Ornn E Searing Charge is down, do not engage right away if Ornn R Call of the Forge God is still available. Close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force during the window when Ornn E Searing Charge is down, especially before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back.
Ornn.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off and let it recharge when it breaks. Fight from the open side, away from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture's pillar and walls. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, do not move forward while it lasts.
Ornn.laning: If Ornn tries to craft items in lane, get close and attack to interrupt him. Once you start getting ahead, push the lane and pressure the turret.
Ornn.phase: Pressure Ornn right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game as you build armor items. In the late game, focus on starting teamfights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than dealing damage yourself.
Ornn.watch: Watch for the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge near the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and nearby walls. If you are marked Brittle by the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, keep your distance until the effect ends. When Ornn R Call of the Forge God appears, sidestep the elemental and avoid standing in the straight line where Ornn can send it back.

Rumble.teamfight: Don't start a fight when Malphite R Unstoppable Force is unavailable. When the enemy team groups together, knock up two or more enemies or engage on a key damage dealer who is alone. If an ally has an AoE ultimate, time it with the knockup from Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Rumble.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rumble deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance with items like Hollow Radiance, but keep one armor item for Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your max health, so avoid a build that only stacks health.
Rumble.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. When engaging after Rumble W Scrap Shield's shield disappears, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility spell, so close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force after he's used Rumble W Scrap Shield and its shield has disappeared. If you're hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, don't stay there and tank the second; back off before it arrives or reposition with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Rumble.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is charged; if it breaks, back off and recharge it. To avoid staying in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter, slow him with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then create distance. Look for an opening to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force after Rumble W Scrap Shield's shield disappears.
Rumble.laning: Use Malphite Q Seismic Shard with mana in mind, then back off after poking to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. If Rumble keeps interrupting the regeneration of Malphite P Granite Shield, get a separate source of lane sustain.
Rumble.phase: Malphite is strongest right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game, once he has two or three armor items. His damage contribution falls off late, so focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your max health, so minimize the time Rumble can stay close to you. If you get hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, immediately create distance before the second harpoon increases the slow and magic resistance reduction. Rumble W Scrap Shield grants a shield as soon as it's activated, so delay your burst damage briefly.

Skarner.teamfight: Don't start a fight while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. Look to knock up at least two enemies or target a key damage dealer caught alone, and coordinate with your team's AoE ultimates if they have one. Don't stand close to the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit, where Skarner R Impale can pull you in.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain and stuns you if he slams you into a wall, so don't stand with your back to one. Keep your distance so Skarner can't get close enough to land empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. If Skarner R Impale suppresses you, Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't get you out, so keep your distance from Skarner and his allies.
Skarner.build: Skarner's main damage is magic, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. After that, build armor, which also helps the damage of Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam. Avoid stacking only health because Skarner deals damage based on your max health.
Skarner.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. Use E after Skarner starts a basic attack to reduce his retaliation. When you can engage, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W Thunderclap → basic attack → Q Seismic Shard → E Ground Slam.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is his only mobility ability, so right after he uses it is your window to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact knocks you into a wall and stuns you, its cooldown is greatly reduced, so back off and account for him engaging again.
Skarner.fight: Trade briefly while Malphite P Granite Shield is full. When it breaks, back off and let it recharge. When Skarner starts an empowered basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to lower his attack speed, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then land two basic attacks. Look for a chance to close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force just after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down.
Skarner.laning: Slow Skarner with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. Don't cast Q every time it's ready at low levels; manage your mana. If you gain an advantage, push the wave and damage the turret.
Skarner.phase: Look for opportunities to fight right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game after building two or three armor items. Your damage contribution falls in the late game, so focus on starting teamfights with R.

Urgot.teamfight: Don't start a fight while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. Look to knock up at least two grouped enemies or target a key damage dealer caught alone. If your team has an AoE ultimate, coordinate the timing with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Urgot.build: Build armor first to counter Urgot's main damage. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then build Plated Steelcaps. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Urgot.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. When Urgot E Disdain is down and you can engage, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W Thunderclap → basic attack → Q Seismic Shard → E Ground Slam.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his mobility, so engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force just after you make him use it. If you need to escape after getting hit by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to retreat.
Urgot.fight: Trade briefly while P Granite Shield is full, and back off when it breaks to recharge it. Staying near Urgot for too long lets his leg cannon damage add up, so after a trade retreat beyond his short range. Use the moment after Urgot E Disdain is down as a chance to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Urgot.laning: Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge P Granite Shield, conserving mana at low levels. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, it's hard to get away on foot, so prioritize dodging it.
Urgot.phase: Malphite is strong right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game after building two or three armor items. In the late game, focus on starting teamfights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than contributing damage.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your max health, so don't stay beside him for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits, its slow and focused fire make it hard to escape, so dodge it as it comes in and use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to create distance if needed. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, get out of range before you reach the execution threshold.

Chogath.teamfight: Don’t start a fight while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. When enemies group up, engage to knock up two or more, or catch a key damage dealer alone. If an ally has an area-of-effect ultimate, time R so they can cast it on the same spot.
Chogath.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Build magic resistance with items such as Hollow Radiance to counter Cho’Gath’s main damage. Leave room for one armor item to preserve the damage from Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam.
Chogath.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. When engaging, follow with Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → E.
Chogath.escape: Look for an opening just after Cho’Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave. Dodge the path of Cho’Gath W Feral Scream, then close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Cho’Gath has no mobility, so once you catch him, he’ll have trouble escaping on his own.
Chogath.fight: Start trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is charged. When it breaks, back off and let it recharge. Dodge Cho’Gath Q Rupture to the side and get out of the path of Cho’Gath W Feral Scream, then slow him with Malphite Q Seismic Shard and close in.
Chogath.laning: In the early game, push or pressure the lane to limit Cho’Gath’s time to scale. Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes can reach in a straight line behind minions, so stand off that line when Cho’Gath basic attacks. Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off without taking damage to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield, but don’t cast Q on cooldown when mana is tight early.
Chogath.phase: Malphite is strong just after learning R Unstoppable Force and in mid game. Cho’Gath gets stronger over time, so late game focus on starting team fights rather than trying to kill him alone.
Chogath.watch: When the warning for Cho’Gath Q Rupture appears under your feet, dodge to the side immediately. If Cho’Gath W Feral Scream silences you, it’s hard to dodge the Q that follows, so don’t start a trade head-on. If you’re at half health or below, move outside the range of Cho’Gath R Feast, which armor can’t mitigate.

Pantheon.teamfight: Don't start a fight when Malphite R Unstoppable Force is unavailable. Use it to knock up two or more grouped enemies, or to target a key damage dealer who is alone. If an ally has an AoE ultimate, time your engage so they can follow up on the knockup.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then Plated Steelcaps and other armor items; this also increases Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Pantheon.combo: For a short trade in melee range, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If you hit Malphite E Ground Slam after Pantheon starts a basic attack, you can reduce his retaliation. When engaging with your ultimate, wait until Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends or you have an angle from the side, then use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Pantheon.escape: Look to engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. Close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. If only one of Pantheon's mobility spells is down, he can still escape with the other, so don't rush your engage.
Pantheon.fight: Pantheon is strong in early trades, so only take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, and back off when it breaks. Don't give him Pantheon W Shield Vault range; deal damage after Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends. When Pantheon's mobility is down, close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Pantheon.laning: Keep minions between you and Pantheon to reduce damage from the long-range hit of Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. Mana is limited at low levels, so don't cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard every time it's up.
Pantheon.phase: Malphite is strong right after learning his ultimate and in mid game, once he has two or three armor items. Pantheon's influence falls off late, and Malphite should focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so don't let him get in range. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, it blocks damage from the front, so wait for it to end or angle in from the side. When you see the tell for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.

Sett.teamfight: Don't start a fight when Malphite R Unstoppable Force is unavailable. When enemies including Sett group together, look to knock up two or more, or target a key damage dealer who is alone. Avoid positions where Sett R The Show Stopper can grab you and throw you toward your allies.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker gets stronger after he takes damage, so create distance after dealing a lot of damage. When it activates, move sideways from the center of the indicator to avoid the true damage. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when enemies are on both sides of him, so position yourself to avoid being caught between Sett and a minion wave. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it grabs you, so watch the range from which Sett can engage and where he could throw you toward your allies.
Sett.build: Build armor first against Sett's basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then build Plated Steelcaps and Frozen Heart. Sett W Haymaker's center deals true damage that resistances can't reduce, so avoid the center instead of stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. When engaging with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, use R → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam. Immediately after dealing a lot of damage, briefly back off to avoid Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.escape: The window while Sett R The Show Stopper is down is your chance to engage, so close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. If Sett E Facebreaker is down too, you can trade without worrying about that crowd control. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can also be used to escape, so if there's a risk of a gank, decide before engaging whether to use it.
Sett.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is charged; if it breaks, back off and recharge it. After Sett starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed. After dealing damage, create distance and watch for Sett W Haymaker. When Sett R The Show Stopper is down, look for a chance to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Sett.laning: Poke Sett with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. If you gain an advantage, push the lane and turn it into turret damage.
Sett.phase: Malphite is strong right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game, once he has two or three armor items. Late game, focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than dealing damage.

Volibear.teamfight: Don’t start a fight without Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Use it to knock up two or more grouped enemies or target a key damage dealer caught alone, and coordinate the timing with an allied AoE ultimate if they have one. Avoid fighting while Volibear P The Relentless Storm has stacked, and don’t linger at low health directly under a turret while Volibear R Stormbringer is available.
Volibear.build: Buy armor first to mitigate the main damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Armor also boosts the damage of Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a concern, get an item that applies Grievous Wounds, but don’t stack health alone because Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on your maximum health.
Volibear.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then use basic attack → E Ground Slam → basic attack. Hitting Volibear with E Ground Slam after he starts a basic attack reduces his attack speed. To engage with your ultimate, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → W Thunderclap → basic attack → Q Seismic Shard → E Ground Slam.
Volibear.escape: Look for an engage after Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, but keep in mind that he can escape with a leap if Volibear R Stormbringer is still available. In particular, close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back up. It’s easier to create an engage window if you let time pass outside basic attack range before Volibear Q Thundering Smash stuns you.
Volibear.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off and let it recharge when it breaks. After Volibear starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed and limit his retaliation. Avoid fighting while Volibear P The Relentless Storm's attack speed stacks are full, and look for an opening once the stacks fall off.
Volibear.laning: At low levels, don’t cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard every time it’s up; save your mana. While dodging Volibear E Sky Splitter’s mark, look for opportunities to push the wave and damage the turret.
Volibear.phase: Actively look for engage opportunities right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game, once you have two or three armor items. In the late game, focus on starting teamfights with R rather than dealing damage.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash boosts his movement speed as he closes in, then stuns with an empowered basic attack, so stay out of basic attack range and wait it out. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. After Volibear W Frenzied Maul marks you, watch for his follow-up attacks and healing.

Darius.teamfight: Don’t start a fight while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. When enemies group up, look to knock up two or more or catch a key damage dealer alone, and time your engage with an ally’s area-of-effect ultimate if they have one. Back off before low health and stacked Darius P Hemorrhage let Darius R Noxian Guillotine secure a takedown and reset its cooldown.
Darius.build: Prioritize armor against Darius’s main physical damage, building from Glacial Buckler into Plated Steelcaps. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate is a problem, finish Thornmail first. Darius E Apprehend ignores some resistances and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so don’t rely on armor alone; build health too.
Darius.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If Darius E Apprehend is down and you have an opening to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Use Malphite R Unstoppable Force carefully before then so you can respond to Darius E Apprehend.
Darius.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is active. When it breaks, back off and let it recharge. After Darius E Apprehend misses, land a basic attack empowered by Malphite W Thunderclap. When Darius starts a basic attack, hit him with Malphite E Ground Slam to lower his attack speed. Back off if Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up or the fight goes on too long.
Darius.laning: Don’t cast low-level Malphite Q Seismic Shard on cooldown, so you don’t run out of mana. Look for a chance to poke just after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions.
Darius.phase: Just after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as armor items stack, look for a window when Darius E Apprehend is down. Malphite’s damage contribution falls off late, so focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with basic attacks, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside E range. When Darius Q Decimate is coming, move outside the axe’s outer edge or hug him to reduce its healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance, and don’t stay in the fight at low enough health to be killed by Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

Irelia.teamfight: In team fights, prioritize Irelia to stop her from taking control with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet. Use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to knock up two or more grouped enemies or target a key damage dealer caught alone. If an ally has an area-of-effect ultimate, time it to hit the targets you knock up with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Irelia.build: Buy armor items first to block the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Armor also increases the damage from Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Irelia P Ionian Fervor, Irelia E Flawless Duet, and Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge.
Irelia.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If you land Malphite E Ground Slam after Irelia starts a basic attack, you can reduce her retaliation. When engaging with Malphite R Unstoppable Force, use R → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Irelia.escape: Immediately after you force Irelia to use Q Bladesurge, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Look for an opening to engage after dodging Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun as well.
Irelia.fight: Trade briefly while Malphite P Granite Shield is ready, then back off to recharge it when it breaks. Use Malphite E Ground Slam just after Irelia starts a basic attack to reduce her attack speed. Look for an opportunity to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge.
