Irelia.laning: Afterward, poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard and back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield, conserving mana at low levels. Don’t leave low-health minions between you and Irelia. If you’ve pushed the lane, damage the turret to secure your advantage.
Irelia.phase: Malphite is strong right after learning R Unstoppable Force and in mid game when you’ve built two or three armor items. Your damage contribution falls off late, so focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge lets her chain dashes through low-health minions, so create distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge’s barrier, wait until the blades disappear. Leaving the barrier exposes you to extra damage and a strong slow.

Poppy.teamfight: Don't start a fight when Malphite R Unstoppable Force is unavailable. After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, look to knock up two or more enemies or target a key damage dealer who is alone. If an ally has an AoE ultimate, time it with the knockup from Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Armor also increases Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone, and don't spend extra resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, attack with Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down is your chance to close the gap. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, then engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. While Poppy E Heroic Charge is available, don't engage with your back to a wall.
Poppy.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is charged; if it breaks, back off and recharge it. For a melee trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. Engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down.
Poppy.laning: Stand in open space to avoid being stunned by Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you can step on the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador first, prevent her from gaining the shield. If you gain an advantage, push the lane and turn it into turret damage.
Poppy.phase: Right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as you build two or three armor items, look for a window after Poppy's charge disruption and stun are down. Late game, focus on starting team fights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than dealing damage directly.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so don't stand with your back to one. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you with its first strike, walk out of the area before the second hit detonates. Don't charge in with Malphite R Unstoppable Force while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of her line of attack.

Yasuo.teamfight: Don’t start a fight without Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Look for a knockup when two or more enemies, including Yasuo, are grouped, or when a key damage dealer is caught alone. Coordinate Malphite R Unstoppable Force’s timing with an allied AoE ultimate if they have one.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first to mitigate the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then build Plated Steelcaps, and afterward consider Frozen Heart and Randuin’s Omen. Armor also increases the damage of Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam.
Yasuo.combo: For a short trade, use Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. When you have a clear chance to target Yasuo, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Yasuo.escape: Yasuo’s Q Steel Tempest stacks reset right after he launches the tornado, so engage then. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is a short-cooldown mobility spell, so don’t engage just because he’s used it once; look for a chance to catch him with crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. You can close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Yasuo.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is charged, then back off and let it recharge when it breaks. When Yasuo starts a basic attack, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and fight back with an empowered basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack, reducing his attack speed. Look for an engage right after Yasuo uses the tornado from Q Steel Tempest, when he briefly has no knockup available.
Yasuo.laning: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with one hit before committing to a trade. Manage the minion wave so it stays thin as it comes toward your side, limiting the platforms for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. At low levels, conserve mana when using Malphite Q Seismic Shard.
Yasuo.phase: Your strong timings are right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game, once you have two or three armor items. Your damage contribution falls off late, so focus on starting teamfights with your ultimate.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks you up with a tornado after hitting twice, so if its stacks are full, move off the line and dodge to the side. Yasuo can use E Sweeping Blade to dash through minions and approach you. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, save projectiles it can block until the wall disappears.

Fiora.build: Prioritize armor against Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework. Get Glacial Buckler and Plated Steelcaps early, and if healing from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and R Grand Challenge is a problem, finish Thornmail for Grievous Wounds. Armor can’t mitigate the true damage from her vitals, and she also deals damage based on your max health, so don’t expect armor alone to solve late-game duels.
Fiora.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap, then use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. If Fiora W Riposte is down and you can engage, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Fiora.escape: Look to close the gap just after Fiora uses Q Lunge. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force; if it’s still available, bait it out first, then engage.
Fiora.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is charged. When it breaks, back off and let it recharge. After Fiora starts a basic attack, hit her with Malphite E Ground Slam to lower her attack speed, then engage when Fiora W Riposte is down.
Fiora.laning: Save mana by not casting low-level Q on cooldown. Stand opposite the side where a vital appears and only trade back briefly when Fiora closes in.
Fiora.phase: Use Malphite’s strength just after learning R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as armor items stack, but don’t duel Fiora alone in a side lane late game.
Fiora.teamfight: Check whether Fiora W Riposte is available, since she can block R with it. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stand against a wall so you don’t expose all four vitals.
Fiora.watch: Watch the direction of Fiora P Duelist’s Dance’s vital and stand on the opposite side. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stand against a wall to block one of its vital angles.

Illaoi.build: Build armor first against the damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Q Tentacle Smash, and W Harsh Lesson. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then get Plated Steelcaps; if her healing is a problem, finish Thornmail first. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t stack health alone.
Illaoi.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and attack in this order: basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. When engaging after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Illaoi.escape: Immediately after you force Illaoi to use W Harsh Lesson, you have an opportunity to engage. If you also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Illaoi.fight: Trade briefly while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off to recharge it when it breaks. Right after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used, slow her with Malphite Q Seismic Shard or close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Don’t continue fighting where Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.laning: Poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. Conserve mana at low levels.
Illaoi.phase: Right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as you build armor, look for openings when Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down. Late game, focus on starting team fights with R Unstoppable Force instead of dealing damage.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group up in front of Illaoi or take fights near her tentacles. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, spread out and wait out its duration, then use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to target two or more grouped enemies or a key damage dealer caught alone.
Illaoi.watch: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit. If she pulls your spirit, decide whether you can fight back or should break the tether. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, don’t group up and move away from where her tentacles can reach.

Kled.build: Kled's main damage is physical, so buy Glacial Buckler early and build armor first. Follow it with Plated Steelcaps and Frozen Heart; armor also increases Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deals magic damage that armor cannot block, so avoid relying on a large health stack alone.
Kled.combo: For a short trade, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack. Use Malphite E Ground Slam after Kled starts a basic attack to reduce his retaliation. To engage with your ultimate, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Kled.escape: Check whether Kled E Jousting is down, and look for an opening especially before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back. After dodging the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Kled.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up, then back off and let it recharge when it breaks. When Kled starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed and create distance before Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth attack. Look for a chance to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force after Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is down.
Kled.laning: Mana is limited at low levels, so do not cast Malphite Q Seismic Shard every time it is off cooldown. If Kled has dismounted from Skaarl, watch his courage meter. If you cannot kill him, create distance but push him out of lane so he cannot remount by killing minions.
Kled.phase: Malphite is strong right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game once he has two or three armor items. Kled weakens after the laning phase and mid game; in the late game, focus on starting teamfights with your ultimate.
Kled.teamfight: Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes from far away and out of vision, so secure vision on the flanks. If you cannot stop it, hold your formation with Malphite up front so the backline is not hit directly.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance before the pull triggers. Kled W Violent Tendencies concentrates damage based on your maximum health in its fourth basic attack, so when he starts attacking, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed and get out before taking all four hits.

Shen.build: Building armor first increases both Malphite W Thunderclap and Malphite E Ground Slam damage and your survivability. However, Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so consider magic resistance as well as armor. If the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash is a problem, consider tenacity before stacking more resistances.
Shen.combo: When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is down, activate Malphite W Thunderclap and use basic attack → Malphite E Ground Slam → basic attack for a short trade. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, basic attacks are blocked, so use your empowered attack after it ends. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses and you can engage with your ultimate, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your window to counterattack. If Shen R Stand United is also down, close the gap and engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Shen.fight: Take short trades while Malphite P Granite Shield is up; if it breaks, back off and recharge it. When Shen starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to reduce his attack speed. The moment Shen E Shadow Dash misses, look for a chance to engage with Malphite R Unstoppable Force.
Shen.laning: In the early game, poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off to recharge Malphite P Granite Shield. Don't cast low-rank Malphite Q Seismic Shard every time it's up, or you may run out of mana. Push the lane to keep Shen occupied with CS, and pressure the turret if Shen leaves lane with Shen R Stand United.
Shen.phase: Malphite is strong right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in mid game as he builds armor. Late game, focus on starting team fights with your ultimate rather than dealing damage.
Shen.teamfight: Alert your team when Shen disappears or you see Shen channeling Shen R Stand United, and avoid fights you can't finish before he arrives. Use Malphite R Unstoppable Force on two or more grouped enemies or a key damage dealer who is alone.
Shen.watch: If taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you'll be hit by empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash. Also move out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault's returning sword. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, it also blocks basic attacks empowered by Malphite W Thunderclap.

Teemo.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Teemo's main damage is magic, so build Hollow Radiance for more magic resistance. Keep one armor item to support the damage of Malphite W Thunderclap and E Ground Slam.
Teemo.combo: After confirming Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, use Malphite R Unstoppable Force → Malphite W Thunderclap → basic attack → Malphite Q Seismic Shard → Malphite E Ground Slam. If you're blinded, don't rush an empowered basic attack; deal damage with abilities or back off until the blind ends.
Teemo.escape: The moment Teemo Q Blinding Dart goes down is your chance to engage with basic attacks mixed in. Even if Teemo W Move Quick speeds him up to create distance, Malphite R Unstoppable Force can close the gap.
Teemo.fight: While Malphite P Granite Shield is up, poke with Malphite Q Seismic Shard, then back off so Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison can end and the shield can recharge. Once Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, close the gap with Malphite R Unstoppable Force and fight. When Teemo starts a basic attack, use Malphite E Ground Slam to lower his attack speed.
Teemo.laning: Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison makes it hard for Malphite P Granite Shield to recharge, so avoid indecisive trades where you take one hit and then back off. Go around bushes without vision or check them with a Control Ward, then counterattack after Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare's stealth ends.
Teemo.phase: Look for chances to engage right after learning Malphite R Unstoppable Force and in the mid game as you build armor. In the late game, focus on starting teamfights with Malphite R Unstoppable Force rather than dealing personal damage.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow paths. Use Malphite R Unstoppable Force to knock up at least two grouped enemies or target a key damage dealer caught alone.
Teemo.watch: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart hits, your basic attacks are negated, so use abilities or back off while blinded. Even one hit from Teemo E Toxic Shot applies ongoing poison damage, so stay out of range until you're ready to commit. Watch for hidden Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow paths.
